title: ASCII Encode
text: Convert Simulink values into uint8 character vector, 1 input, 1 output, {Variable types} sets Simulink ® data types allowed for input ports; {Format string} sets the format specifiers for converting values to ASCII, {Number of variables} sets the number of block inputs and {Max output string length} sets the maximum length of converted character vector. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Numbered ports that receive values to encode numeric

params.name: Format string
params.values: Format specifiers for converting values to ASCII %d\r (default) | %c | %i | %o | %u | %x | %e | %f | %g

params.name: Max output string length
params.values: Maximum length of converted character vector, in bytes 128 (default) | integer

params.name: Variable types
params.values: Simulink ® data types allowed for input ports {’double’} (default) | {’int8’} | {’uint8’} | {’int16} | {’uint16’} | {’int32’} | {’uint32’}
